title: AI Shopping is a Thing Now?
description:
AI is starting to move from advising to actually spending.

Not suggesting.
Not reminding.
Spending.

This short shows the shift: AI agents getting wallets, buying in seconds, and moving routine payments from humans to software. If this keeps scaling, the center of the consumer economy starts to change with it.

GREENBACK
Finance, made plain.

Short Description Version
The next payment revolution is not a new card.
It is software becoming the spender.
